odyssey.title: The Heir
odyssey.character_basis: Earnest young learner seeking confidence; hesitant recognition, enthusiastic overfiring and simple equipment.
odyssey.behavior_source: authored persona + native bot AI; not a neural model or pro recording
odyssey.voice_owner: Tom; existing ElevenLabs voice mapped by clone_id; no voice IDs embedded

quirks.name: The hesitant challenger
quirks.effect: Native aggression 30/100; pressure appetite, not a guaranteed path.

quirks.name: Seeks the company of allies
quirks.effect: Native teamwork 65/100; squad preference when teammates exist.

quirks.name: Late recognition
quirks.effect: Configured reaction 650 ms, subject to the native AI and server tick.

quirks.name: The unsteady first aim
quirks.effect: Aim offset scale 0.9; finite acceleration cap 5000. Calibration required.

quirks.name: Checks before committing
quirks.effect: Configured attack delay 250 ms after the native AI decides to engage.

quirks.name: The enthusiastic spray
quirks.effect: Burst target 9 shots, single-shot share 8%; existing trigger suppression.

quirks.name: The nervous crouch
quirks.effect: Extra crouch at burst start with probability 70%; native crouching can also occur.

quirks.name: Restless travel
quirks.effect: 6 extra jumps/min target while running outside combat; zero means no injected jumps.

quirks.name: Forgets stealth often
quirks.effect: 20% walk chance per eligible second near a recent heard step/reload; memory 1s. Not global enemy awareness.

quirks.name: The forgiving SMG
quirks.effect: Full-buy primary T/CT: p90/p90; subject to money and alias support.

quirks.name: Keeps the starting pistol
quirks.effect: Eco sidearm T/CT: glock/hkp2000; no armor/utility splurge.

quirks.name: A modest force buy
quirks.effect: Force primary T/CT: mac10/mp9, then vest; subject to affordability.

quirks.name: One simple utility lesson
quirks.effect: Utility buy palette: flashbang. Native AI chooses deployment; no authored lineups or fakes.

quirks.name: Slowly finds his focus
quirks.effect: AimFocusInitial 3.0: deliberately loose initial focus; no live confidence/learning system.
